name: nearvia-monorepo
description: NEARVIA - Work Within Reach | Hyperlocal Quick-Work Marketplace
author: NEARVIA Core Team

scripts.dev:all: npx -y concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,emerald "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/api && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/web && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/admin
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/types && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/validation && npm run build --workspace=@nearvia/config
